shabad.source_english: Codes of Conduct and Other Panthic Sources

verses.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮ ਗੁਰੋਂ ਕੇ ਭੋਗ ਹਿਤ ਭਾਂਜਨ ਸੁਧ ਮੰਗਾਇ॥
verses.translit_en: piratham guro(n) ke bhog hit bhaa(n)jan sudh ma(n)gai||

en.bdb: Before performing the bhog with a knife, obtain well cleansed vessels;

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਲੰਗਰ ਕੀਨ ਹੈ ਸੋ ਸਭ ਤਹਾਂ ਧਰਾਇ॥੧੩੬॥
verses.translit_en: jo jo la(n)gar keen hai so sabh tahaa(n) dharai||136||

en.bdb: Use only those, which have already been used in Langar.
